description: Northstar OS model suite — single source of truth for tiered model selection. Text tiers T1/T2/T3 (DeepSeek cloud lane + the local Bojo interaction layer), the Ty orchestrator/coding worker (on demand, see local_engines), vision tiers V1/V2/V3 (understanding + generation), and the video lane. model_router.py loads this; services route through shared/service-model-map.json. All prices are Sept-2026 list rates and are planning values — the ledger records actual usage.cost per call. LOCAL TEXT TIERS RESOLVE TO BOJO: bojo is the resident, CPU-pinned Ollama model that actually serves T1-T3 interaction. Ty is not an Ollama model and is not a chat tier — it is a llama.cpp worker started on demand, so naming it as a `local` text model made every local tier resolve to an id Ollama does not have.

T1.label: T1 Fast — routing, extraction, summaries, drafts

T2.label: T2 Core — main reasoning / copy / analysis

local_engines.description: The two local engines, measured on this machine (RTX 5080 Laptop 16 GB, 15.4 GB system RAM). Nothing here is a target - each value was read off the running server or its launch line. docs/LOCAL_ENGINES.md is the prose copy.

ty.residency: on demand - not a service, not an Ollama model
ty.vision: unavailable - the mmproj is withheld for VRAM; use the V tiers
ty.limits: 65536 is a measured ceiling on this card, not a preference: 64576 crashed the CUDA flash-attention path. q8_0 KV caps around 32K here.

bojo.role: user-facing brain - resident T1/T2/T3 interaction layer
bojo.capabilities: vision, tools and thinking are present
bojo.residency: kept warm; evicted by unload_brain before any ComfyUI render

V1.label: V1 Lite — screenshots, OCR, browser-control, volume drafts

V2.label: V2 Standard — presentations, brand decks, product stills

V3.label: V3 Premium — ad visuals, A+ content, UGC, text-heavy graphics

cost_recording: Every generation call records the provider's returned usage cost (OpenRouter usage.cost, fal usage.price) into the credit ledger; config costs are planning values only.

local_media_lanes.description: Local media lanes actually wired in the Design Studio. Every one runs on this machine; no provider key is read.

edit.note: Text-faithful edit/refine of a REAL image. Diffusion must never own final copy - the OCR drift gate (text_fidelity.verify_edit_preserves_copy) blocks an edit that rewrites the label.

cutout.note: RemoveBackground MASK marks the BACKGROUND in this build; the graph inverts it before it becomes alpha.

upscale.note: Model upscaling is disabled: RealESRGAN x4 aborted the ComfyUI process on a 1216px input (00_STATE known_issues). Upscale a CLEAN PLATE before the text composite.

prepress.profiles: auto-detected on this machine (Windows ships RSWOP.icm)
prepress.note: CMYK + soft proof + CIE76 gamut + total area coverage

readiness.note: one verdict across prepress, copy (OCR-diff), MAIN framing and dieline structure
